summary: Maps attribute values from one numeric range to another and writes to the same, an existing, or a new attribute. It supports point, vertex, and primitive attributes, component swizzles, per-component parameter lanes, and optional type casting.

key_params.name: castto
key_params.note: Automatic, float, or int output cast

key_concepts: Maps input attribute values from a From low/high range into a To low/high output range.
Operates on point, vertex, or primitive attributes and can restrict work to groups.
Input and output scopes may reference components or swizzle order, enabling component reordering while reranging.
Can write back into the same attribute, an existing different attribute, or a new auto-typed attribute with optional cast override.
common_gotchas: Component swizzles like P(1) P(0) or P.yx can intentionally reorder output components.
Set Parameter Size to match vector components when each axis needs a different range.
Reranging into the same attribute is destructive; write to a new attribute when the original scale is still needed.
